title: feat(wordcount): support aggregated statistics for multi-cursor multiple selections

commits.message:
feat(wordcount): support multi-cursor multi-selection aggregate statistics

- Replace single getSelection() with getSelections() to fetch all cursor ranges
- Filter empty cursor ranges and deduplicate overlapping selected text
- Reuse existing countMarkdown to sum chars/words/lines for status bar display
- Add regression unit test for multi-cursor scenario
- Fully backward compatible with original single selection logic
